The following events took place in '''112 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Births==
*Components for a [[3PO-series protocol droid/Legends|3PO-series protocol droid]] that would eventually be included in [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] are constructed on [[Affa/Legends|Affa]].<ref name="note1">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]'' states that this as the year that C-3PO was built. This fact was overridden by [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which established he was built by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], but later works such as the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]] and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'' establish that his components date back this far. The Databank also confirms these components were built on Affa.</ref>
